apiImpactNote: No endpoint, request field, response schema or error status is added or changed. The story uses the two existing admin operations owned and built by RWB-E1-043 and adds one handler bean for the free-form table code data_product. A repeat is a 409 Problem already described by API v4 E409; ReferenceLoad needs no message field.
openapiEvidence: api/recovery-api-v4.yaml and frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts are not edited; no openapi-fetch client is regenerated.

handlerContract.spec: RWB-E1-043 revision 10 'Reference load handler'; this story conforms and asks E1-043 for nothing
methods: ValidationReport validate(ReferenceLoadFile file) -> K0-H, K0-R, K1-K5; writes nothing
int apply(UUID loadId, ReferenceLoadFile file, LocalDate validFrom) -> @Transactional; 14 updates by product_code; returns 14
boolean supportsRollback() -> not overridden (SPI default false; ASM-E1001-20, GAP-E1001-24)
List<String> changeSummary(ReferenceLoadFile file) -> not overridden (SPI default List.of())

liveSpiSignatures.ReferenceLoadFile: record ReferenceLoadFile(String tableCode, LocalDate validFrom, List<String> columns, List<Map<String,Object>> rows)
liveSpiSignatures.RowCheckFailure: record RowCheckFailure(int row, String column, String messageCode, Map<String,String> placeholders); row is the 1-based data row, 0 = whole file; column may be null
liveSpiSignatures.note: The spec's prose in SPEC-015 names the RowCheckFailure fields as (messageCode, placeholders, column); the live record order above is authoritative and the handler constructs it positionally. PG-E1001-01 records this wording difference; no behaviour changes.

checkOrder: then per data row in file order: K0-R required and width, K2 system of record, K3 owner user id, K4 owner role, K5 refresh cycle

checks.K0-H: columns exactly product_code,product_name,definition,system_of_record,owner_role,owner_user_id,refresh_cycle,expected_by, once each, in order; failure MSG-P3-027 {table=data_product, check=the header must hold the 8 catalog columns}, row 0
checks.K0-R: product_code, product_name, definition, owner_role, refresh_cycle required (empty = MSG-GEN-001 {field}); every present value fits its column (too long = MSG-P3-027 {table=data_product, check=value too long for <column>}); system_of_record and owner_user_id are excluded from required and are covered by K2/K3
checks.K1: non-empty product_code set equals DP01-DP14, each once; MSG-P1-004 {products} = missing codes ascending, or the duplicate/unexpected codes when nothing is missing; row 0
checks.K2: SystemOfRecordGrammar F1-F3 whole-value match; empty is K2; MSG-P1-003 {product}, column system_of_record
checks.K3: owner_user_id present and a UUID; MSG-P1-003 {product}, column owner_user_id
checks.K4: owner_role is an active role.role_code (LOV-ROLE per ASM-E1001-10); MSG-P1-007 {row, field=owner_role, values=the role codes in LOV-ROLE}
checks.K5: refresh_cycle in DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, ON_CHANGE (PS v6 sort_order); MSG-P1-007 {row, field=refresh_cycle, values=DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, ON_CHANGE}

handlerContract.findingOrder: K0-H, K1, then rows in file order, each row K0-R, K2, K3, K4, K5; K0 never suppresses K2/K3 for the same row
handlerContract.messagePassThrough: E1-043 SPEC-025 L13 returns the first failure's messageCode, placeholders and column unchanged and builds detail from every failure; the handler therefore supplies {table} for K0-H/K0-R and {row} for K4/K5 itself
handlerContract.applyBehaviour: one transaction in the approve call; loads the 14 rows by product_code in one query; updates the seven file fields, valid_from and updated_at; version +1 through @Version; never inserts or deletes; a missing product throws and rolls all 14 back
handlerContract.applyDeviation: The published apply signature carries no actor, so data_product.updated_by is not writable through the SPI. updated_at is written; the approver is audited by E1-043 in reference_version.approver_user_id. Recorded as PG-E1001-02 (Blocker = No); the field-matrix cell is not claimed as covered.
handlerContract.repeat: repeatMessage returns MSG-P1-011 {source=data product catalog, date=validFrom}; E1-043 answers 409 before the valid-from check, for any business date, nothing written
